card.name: The keep-out-of-reach warning
card.fires_on: The word "this" (or "Keep") in the iron overdose warning "Keep this product out of reach of children". Also "should" in advice to patients about antibiotics.

modes.label: Iron warning wording
modes.description: "this" or "Keep" in the standard child-safety sentence after the iron overdose warning.
modes.example: Keep<< this>> product out of reach of children.

modes.label: Antibiotic patient counseling
modes.description: "should" in a sentence telling patients what they should be told about antibiotics.
